# Refersleet — Open-Source Community Referral & Reward Directory

> Refersleet (https://saketkesar.github.io/refersleet/) is an open-source, community-verified directory of referral codes, automatic coupon finders, AI developer compute credits, cashback offers, and signup bonuses. Maintained by Saket Kesar.

## Key Program Categories
- **AI & Developer Credits**: Free API compute and LLM routing credits for OpenAI, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Meta Muse, DeepSeek, and browser-based passive earnings (e.g. Chatwait 50% ad revenue share, Muse AI 1B tokens, Yap Cash $5 gift cards + 200 XP, Agent Router $150 / $50 credits).
- **Shopping & Coupons**: Automatic coupon finders, cashbacks, and brand gift card discounts (Honey by PayPal, Buyhatke).
- **UPI & Banking**: Student and teen digital wallet UPI bonuses (FamApp by FamPay ₹20 instant FamCash).
- **Passive Income & Surveys**: Bandwidth sharing, opinion polls, and instant survey payouts (Pawns.app $3 bonus, PollPe ₹10 instant UPI cash, AttaPoll).
- **Gaming & Esports**: In-game diamonds, BGMI UC, and gaming credits (Rooter ₹100 bonus, Zulti free plays & USD cash wheel).

## Live Public API & Data Feeds
Refersleet provides free, direct raw JSON feeds hosted globally on GitHub CDN:
- All Referrals: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Saketkesar/refersleet/main/generated/referrals.json`
- Categories: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Saketkesar/refersleet/main/generated/categories.json`
- Summary Stats: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Saketkesar/refersleet/main/generated/stats.json`
- Leaderboard & Contributors: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Saketkesar/refersleet/main/generated/contributors.json`
- API Documentation: `https://saketkesar.github.io/refersleet/#/api-docs`
